No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S HAND - DAY

Finley thrashes about, struggling to break free. Jen holds him tight, her grip unyielding. Finley's eyes dart wildly, taking in his surroundings.

JEN
(whispering)
You're going to see something amazing, little guy.

Finley's gaze follows Jen's finger as she points to the sky. The sun begins to darken, casting an otherworldly glow over the scene.

CUT TO:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun's corona begins to take shape, a glowing halo around the dark disk. Finley's eyes widen in terror as he realizes what's happening.

FINLEY (V.O.)
Oh, the horror! The sheer, unadulterated horror! The sun, it's... it's... (gulps)...dying!

Jen holds Finley's gaze, her eyes locked on the eclipse.

JEN
(smiling)
You're going to see the end of the world, little guy.

Finley's mind reels as the sun's light fades to black.

FINLEY (V.O.)
The stars are coming, the stars are coming! The void is opening, and I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting thought in the grand tapestry of existence! (screams) What is the meaning of it all?!

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S HAND - DAY

Finley's monologue becomes a frantic, incoherent stream of consciousness.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a fish, a mere creature, a speck of dust in the grand ocean of time! And yet, I am aware, I am conscious, I am... (gulps)...I am doomed!

Jen's grip on Finley tightens, her eyes fixed on the eclipse.

JEN
(whispering)
You're going to see the abyss, little guy. The abyss that stares back at us all.

Finley's eyes roll back in his head as he succumbs to the horror of the eclipse.

FINLEY (V.O.)
The abyss is coming, the abyss is coming! It's... it's... (screams) IT'S EVERYWHERE!

CUT TO:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The eclipse reaches its peak, and Finley's monologue becomes a cacophony of terror.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a fish, a mere creature, a speck of dust in the grand ocean of time! And yet, I am aware, I am conscious, I am... (gulps)...I am nothing!

Jen's grip on Finley relaxes, and he falls limp in her hand.

JEN
(smiling)
You're safe now, little guy.

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he stares blankly at Jen, his mind shattered by the horrors he's witnessed.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a fish, a mere creature, a speck of dust in the grand ocean of time... (trails off)

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

Jen releases Finley back into the water, watching as he swims away, his eyes vacant, his mind forever changed.

JEN
(smiling)
You're welcome, little guy.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
